name: Pyrewood Ambush
summary: In Pyrewood Village, Deathstalker Faerleia waits while Arugal's council keeps the afflicted in line. The Forsaken aim to break his hold on the town and weaken his position in Shadowfang Keep.

sections.title: Striking the Puppets
sections.body: Deathstalker Faerleia waits in Pyrewood Village's town hall for the local leaders. Archmage Arugal tends his dark sorceries in Shadowfang Keep, leaving the Pyrewood Council to keep order among the afflicted villagers. Faerleia plans to ambush the council. Without its mediation, the Forsaken hope the worgen in the woods and village streets will break free of Arugal's control.

sections.title: A Decapitation Strike
sections.body: The ambush strikes every sitting member of Pyrewood's government, including Lord Mayor Morrison. The councilors die as they enter their meeting chamber, and the village loses its leaders. For the Undercity, the slaughter clears a path to taking Pyrewood Village and laying siege to Arugal in Shadowfang Keep.

faq.answer: Deathstalker Faerleia is a Forsaken operative in the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken's espionage and assassination guild. She established a foothold in Pyrewood Village to coordinate strikes against Arugal's local support.

faq.q: Why does the Forsaken want the Pyrewood Council dead?
faq.answer: Arugal relies on the council to keep the cursed human villagers compliant and under control. The Forsaken believe killing its leaders will throw Pyrewood into chaos and turn the worgen against Arugal.
Lord Mayor Morrison leads the Pyrewood Council. Before the Deathstalkers' ambush, he oversees municipal matters with councilmen Smithers, Thatcher, and Brunswick.

faq.q: Where does this ambush take place?
faq.answer: The ambush takes place inside Pyrewood Village's municipal town hall in southern Silverpine Forest, just down the road from Shadowfang Keep.

faq.q: What is the relationship between the Council and Arugal?
faq.answer: The council is Arugal's administrative mouthpiece. While he remains in Shadowfang Keep conducting dark experiments, the council manages villagers who become ferocious beasts under cover of night.

faq.q: Does killing the council free Pyrewood from the curse?
faq.answer: No. Killing the council removes Arugal's mortal puppets but does not lift the villagers' lupine curse. The Forsaken are left to face a town full of hostile, uncontrolled monsters.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, securing southern Silverpine helps defend the Undercity's borders. Killing Arugal's sycophants brings them closer to claiming Pyrewood.
As a rogue, you know the Deathstalkers' craft: infiltrate enemy strongholds, lie in wait, and eliminate commanders in their own seat of power.
As a member of the Horde, you weaken Arugal's network and the threat to the Horde's route through Silverpine Forest toward the southern borders.
